sentences.text: The Group of 15 -LRB- G-15 -RRB- is an informal forum set up to foster cooperation and provide input for other international groups , such as the World Trade Organization and the Group of Eight .	World Trade Organization	World Trade Organization	Group of Eight	G8

It was established at the Ninth Non-Aligned Movement Summit Meeting in Belgrade , Yugoslavia , in September 1989 , and is composed of countries from Latin America , Africa , and Asia with a common goal of enhanced growth and prosperity .	Non-Aligned Movement	Non-Aligned Movement	Belgrade	Belgrade	Yugoslavia	Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia
The G-15 focuses on cooperation among developing countries in the areas of investment , trade , and technology .	developing countries	developing countries
Membership has since expanded to 18 countries , but the name has remained unchanged .

Chile , Iran and Kenya have since joined the Group of 15 , whereas Yugoslavia is no longer part of the group ; Peru , a founding member-state , decided to leave the G-15 in 2011 .	Yugoslavia	Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia
